# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 22 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 22 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**1** [...] the wicked [...] lost in their delusion [...] and they refused to listen [...]

**2** [...] they strayed from the path You intended, and [...] their detestable acts [...]

**3** [...] with stubborn hearts they wandered astray, and [...] they never sought You [...]

**4** [...] and they refused to choose what pleases You, and they would not listen [...]

**5** [...] they plotted together against Your covenant, and the members of Your community [...]

**6** [...] they spoke against You with defiant words, and they would not [...]

**7** [...] with their lying lips, for they have no foundation in Your truth [...]

**8** [...] and in their hearts they hatched the plots of the Evil One, and they approached You with divided loyalty [...]

**9** [...] they have no foundation in Your truth, and a poisonous root [...] infects their plans,

**10** [...] and with stubborn hearts they wander, pursuing You through worthless idols [...]

**11** [...] You opened the ears of those made from dust to Your truth and [...] You taught [...]

**12** [...] because You know the motive behind every action, and You can read every word before it is spoken,

**13** [...] You shaped their hearts through Your [...] and through Your deep insight [...]

**14** [...] so they would be kept from sinning, and [...] so they would turn away from all [...]

**15** [...] and You trained them through the secrets of Your wondrous ways, and all for the sake of Your glory [...]

**16** [...] You opened their ears to hear [...] amazing things [...]

**17** [...] for the honor of Your name You acted, to make great [...] truth [...]

**18** [...] and to plant the members of Your community among humankind [...]

**19** [...] to declare Your wonders to every generation, and through Your powerful deeds [...]

**20** [...] the tongue that You created has refused to turn back from its defiance [...]

**21** [...] instead it has spoken evil, and the result of their scheming [...] they have not [...]

**22** [...] and they hardened their hearts, and they refused to walk Your way [...]

**23** [...] deep down they rejected the teaching of true knowledge, and they would not embrace truth [...]

**24** [...] and You turned Your face away from them, and Your [...] they did not [...]

**25** [...] because they despised what You commanded, and they found no joy in it [...]

**26** [...] they lived by the stubbornness of their hearts and never sought [...]

**27** [...] their guilt piled up enormously, and [...] in the fire [...]

**28** [...] and You cut them off from Your covenant, and everything they did [...]

**29** [...] in Your anger You judged them, and [...] with burning fury [...]

**30** [...] and You hurled the wicked into a fire that burns forever,

**31** [...] and all the liars will cease to exist, and those who practice evil [...]

**32** [...] because Your verdict is just, and no one survives Your anger [...]

**33** [...] and Your truth stands firm through every generation, and everything [...]

**34** [...] forever and ever [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 22 reads as a prophetic indictment against covenant-breakers. The repetitive "stubbornness of heart" motif rendered dynamically to avoid monotony while preserving the rhetorical drumbeat of the original. "Belial" rendered as "the Evil One" for contemporary readers unfamiliar with Second Temple demonology. The fiery judgment imagery resonates with later apocalyptic traditions.*
